adaptations: None in these files: change them in fedora-aurora first and copy them here. The package (overlay.nix aurora-m5-platform-config) puts the coreutils, grep, sed and util-linux store paths on the hook's PATH and its shebang in the store, points the unit's install and data paths into the store, and modules/m5-platform.nix links the hook into /etc/systemd/system-sleep, where NixOS's systemd-sleep runs hooks.
